activation_comparison.interpretation: The first changed recorded output localizes an observed execution boundary for the controlled inputs. Intermediate values between observation points, unique causal parameter identity, semantic correctness and untested inputs require separate evidence.

interpretation: Controlled full-model observations for the supplied checkpoints, prompts and CPU runtime. Interpret numerical failures and recovery from the recorded measurements. Broader security and behavioral claims require separate evidence.

candidate.interpretation: Local full-model observations cover only these prompts and runtime settings. Numerical failure requires attribution to a controlled checkpoint comparison.
candidate.trace_coverage: Ordered observations of embedding, each decoder module and residual, final normalization and logits. Statistics cover all elements in each observed output; hashes use row-major F32 conversions. Intentional attention-mask infinities are excluded. First observed nonfinite output identifies a numerical boundary, not by itself a unique causal weight or semantic defect.
